# Elmvale Global

> Elmvale Global supports beauty and fragrance brands with packaging sourcing, supplier comparison, sampling and project coordination.

Elmvale Global is a packaging sourcing and project coordination service. It is not a packaging manufacturer and is not limited to a fixed catalogue.
